description: This header file defines the interface for a device descriptor handler responsible for managing device whitelist and blacklist downloads, updates, and related callbacks.

methods.name: deviceServiceDeviceDescriptorsInit
methods.description: Initializes the device descriptor handler and sets callback functions for when device descriptors are ready and when they are updated.

methods.name: deviceServiceDeviceDescriptorsDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the device descriptor handler during shutdown.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorsUpdateWhitelist
methods.description: Processes the whitelist URL, downloads the list if necessary, and invokes the callback when the list is valid.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorsUpdateBlacklist
methods.description: Processes the blacklist URL and downloads the list if required.
